needs_clinician: URGENCY LABEL — the row is labelled URGENT and the concept has moved twice on one axis. v1 Kinyarwanda 'ntarya' (does not eat); en/fr/sw 'refuses to eat'; the speaker's rewrite 'ntabwo arimo kubasha kurya' (is NOT ABLE to eat). Not able is the stronger claim, and IF03 and PA02 — both built on IMCI's 'not able to drink or breastfeed' — are CRITICAL while this stays URGENT. BUT the IMCI danger sign is drinking and breastfeeding, NOT eating: a child who will not eat but still drinks is not in the severe class. So the answer is not simply 'relabel CRITICAL'.
